material_findings.finding_note: 称三人因“没有兵器和马匹”而发愁；原文明确提到的是缺少马匹，随后才置办兵器。
material_findings.reason: Accepted scene adds that the three men were troubled by lacking weapons, but the original says they only lamented having no horses; weapons were then prepared after receiving materials.
material_findings.required_fix: 改为“三人招募了三百多名勇士，却苦于没有马匹”；随后写张世平、苏双赠送镔铁等物，他们才打造兵器。
